description: This file defines a React hook named useProjectCost that fetches and formats the total cost of a project from a backend API. It manages state for data, loading, and error, and provides a method to refetch the data. It also includes a currency formatting utility.

methods.name: useProjectCost
methods.description: A React hook that fetches and returns the aggregated project cost, loading state, error, a refetch function, and a formatted cost string.
